Multi-scale Grid is indeed the configuration with the lowest eval loss among all configurations. The claim is approximately supported within expected stochastic variation.

results_section.claim: 5. The multi-scale grid approach with L1 regularization takes approximately 79% longer to train.

However, the actual run_0 baseline (41.993s) differs from the paper's claimed baseline (44.24s) by ~5%, yielding an actual ratio of ~88.6% instead of 79%.
